observed_failure.scope: One first move failed before a complete media window or terminal idle observation. Actual browser fallback/refusal independently passed. No new quality or idle pass.

investigation.known_mechanism: StartInvocation.held_owners calls owners, which consults Policy.entry through replacement_source_owner. A contended packet registry returns NotReady, mapped to ParticipantControlError::Authority and then StreamControlError::Authority. Preparation and commit already use exact captured entries; start did not.
investigation.causation_limit: The original initial-mute log reports Authority but not the failing subcheck. Controlled registry exclusion will verify this concrete mechanism; it cannot by itself prove that registry contention caused every observed initial-mute failure.
investigation.fix: Capture exact source/retained Connection references before begin_native_replacement_start_with_read; retain them in StartInvocation and rederive owners under the original current Store read, cancellation and deadline at each check. No retries of negotiation/mute or mutation IDs, and no packet authority bypass.

verification.expected: Actual initial mute under the real registry mutex rejects old lookup, accepts current captured owners and rejects expired invocation; the same original replacement then carries both video directions and joins original owners.
